most_relevant.description: They are fraud and cheaters dont go fo fill up cng at this pump sometimes the actual gas shown in meter is not filled in ur tank and they said its ur car tank sensor mistake or else but actually they cheat and mostly not accepting card and online payment and didnt give back the change.worst ever adani cng pump

"Visited this Adani CNG station to refuel my Bajaj Freedom 125. The staff was familiar with the bike and used the standard nozzle without any issues. Gas pressure was excellent (around 200 bar), so I got a full tank quickly. The lines were moving fast. Highly recommended for CNG bike owners in the area!"

their staff mostly not accepte Cards.
they never give 2 or 4 rupee change back.
High Gas pressure is always good.
Free Air is not Available.
some more arrangement for CNG fueling, time taking pump.
Overall all average experience.

I had reffered the review of most of people still i thought to experience personal but review given by majority of people are True since I had experienced the same. U can experience too.

Adani has to review & take strict action.

Adani staff are behaving very bad & unprofessional with customer.

Additional there is zero management since utilisation of fuel filling can be done much better to address the quie but staff is not bought about it & no one senior looking around.

I think this could be one of major reason across because of which Adani Gas share is falling down drastically.
